facts.fact: The Official Gazette special issue of 20 November 2025 carries a notice in which the Rwanda Standards Board (RSB), established under Law N° 50/2013, publishes a list of standards as National Standards; the passages read do not show the list or name any information technology or data standard.

systems.country_label: Rwanda Standards Board / Ikigo cy'Igihugu Gitsura Ubuziranenge

note: Passages show the notice header only; the standards listed are not in the text, so no published IT or data standard and no certification fact.
